findSubtitles.none: No {{language}} subtitles found online for this video.

auth.setUpHint: Create the admin account. You can add family and friends later.

home.welcomeHint: Add a folder of movies, shows or music to get started.
home.scanningHint: New titles show up here as soon as they're found.

file.title: File details
file.notYet: Matinee hasn't looked at this file in detail yet. It reads every file slowly in the background, so this fills in on its own.
file.stale: The file changed since this was recorded; it will be looked at again soon.

watchList.emptyHint: Open a movie or show and choose Watch list to keep it here for later. Movies leave the list once you've watched them.

boxSet.notFoundHint: None of its titles are in a library now.

library.seenEverything: You’ve seen everything in this library.
library.appearAsFound: Titles appear as they are found.
library.noMedia: Matinee looked in {{paths}} and found no media.

collection.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? The titles stay in your library.
collection.joinByRules: Titles join by themselves when they match the rules.
collection.howToAdd: Open a movie or show and choose Collections to add it.

collections.noneHint: A smart collection fills itself from rules, like unwatched 80s action. Box sets show up here once two of their titles are in a library.
collections.name: Name
collections.rulesHint: Titles that match these filters join by themselves as the library changes.
collections.shareWithEveryone: Share with everyone on this server

filters.title: Filters
filters.highestFirstSwitch: Highest first; switch to lowest first
filters.lowestFirstSwitch: Lowest first; switch to highest first
filters.onlyWatchList: Only titles on my watch list
filters.nobody: Nobody by that name in this library.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.guestHint: Everyone at home without an account shares this theme.
appearance.hint: Your theme follows you to the Matinee apps on your phone and TV.
appearance.serverThemeHint: What everyone sees until they pick their own, and on the sign-in page.
appearance.addYourOwn: To add your own, put a theme file in the server's themes folder, in its data folder.

newFiles.title: New files
newFiles.intro: Matinee notices files you add, rename or delete and updates the library a few seconds after they finish copying.

summary.pollingShare: Checked for new files every {{every}} (network share)

auto.label: Automatic
auto.hint: Right away on this server's own disks. Network shares (SMB, NFS) don't announce changes, so Matinee checks those every {{every}}.

poll.label: Check on a timer
poll.hint: Every folder is checked every {{every}}. Pick this if new files on a disk don't show up by themselves.

off.label: Off
off.hint: New files show up at the next full rescan, or when you press Scan.

newFiles.rescan: Every library is also rescanned in full every {{every}}, which catches anything else, like a file replaced in place on a share.
newFiles.rescanOff: Full rescans are turned off on this server (MATINEE_SCAN_INTERVAL=0).

analysis.title: Media analysis
analysis.intro: Matinee slowly reads each file for its quality, sound and languages, and again whenever a file changes.

state.slowDisk: Files are slow to read; resting for a few minutes

gentle.label: Gentle
gentle.hint: One file every few seconds, and none while the server is converting something for playback.

normal.label: Normal
normal.hint: Files back to back, still at the lowest priority.

off.label: Off
off.hint: Paused until you turn it back on.

intros.label: Find TV intros
intros.hint: Once every file is analyzed, Matinee listens to the start of each season’s episodes for the intro they share, so players can offer Skip intro.
intros.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} episodes checked, {{found}} with an intro

thumbnails.label: Seek bar previews
thumbnails.hint: Small pictures of each video that show above the seek bar while you scrub. They take about 4 MB per movie.

all.label: All videos
all.hint: Made for every video in the background, after the analysis and at its speed.

onPlay.label: When played
onPlay.hint: Made the first time someone plays a video. Saves time and space on big libraries.

off.label: Off
off.hint: None are made, and the seek bar shows only the time.

profileSettings.title: Profiles
profileSettings.intro: Profiles share a sign-in but keep their own progress, watch list and theme. Kids profiles only see what you allow. A PIN keeps a profile, or the account itself, to its owner.
profileSettings.homeDevices: Devices on your home network that haven’t signed in
profileSettings.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Their progress and watch list go too.
profileSettings.name: Name
profileSettings.kidsLibraries: What this profile sees in each library. By rating hides titles rated above the {{level}} level and titles with no rating. Kids profiles can’t open Settings or make requests.

report.thanks: Thanks, an admin will take a look.

quality.label: Quality
quality.confirm: Switch to {{name}}? {{app}} will look for copies that match.

upcoming.connect: Connect Radarr or Sonarr to see the movies and episodes on their way.
upcoming.notConnected: An admin hasn't connected Radarr or Sonarr to this server.
upcoming.intro: New episodes and movie releases over the next two months that aren't in yet.
upcoming.unavailable: {{apps}} didn't answer, so some may be missing.
upcoming.nothing: Nothing on the way. Ask for something new from Requests.

link.title: Sign in a device
link.intro: Enter the code your phone or TV is showing.
link.ready: It will be ready in a few seconds.
link.warning: Only approve a device you're holding or can see. It gets the same access you have.

integrations.title: Radarr and Sonarr
integrations.intro: Connect them so people can ask for movies and shows, see what's coming soon, and report problems with what they watch.
integrations.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{app}}? Titles already in it stay there.
integrations.whoCanAdd: Who can add movies and shows

approve.label: Ask, then an admin approves
approve.detail: Anyone with an account can ask for a title. It waits for an admin.

auto.label: Add right away
auto.detail: What people ask for goes straight to Radarr or Sonarr.

off.label: Only admins add titles
off.detail: Everyone else can still see what’s coming soon and report problems.

overseerr.intro: Connect it to add a Discover tab: what's trending, recommendations based on what people watch, and a way to ask for anything. Jellyseerr works too.
overseerr.requestAs: Requests from people without an Overseerr account
overseerr.sameName: People with an Overseerr account of the same name ask as themselves. Overseerr decides which requests need approval, from each user's permissions there.
overseerr.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Overseerr? The Discover tab goes away.

requests.noReports: You haven’t reported any problems. Use “Report a problem” on a title.
requests.confirmReplace: Delete this file of {{title}} and download another copy? The new one shows up after it downloads and the library is scanned.

settings.tmdbNotice: Posters and descriptions come from <site>TMDB</site>. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.findingArtwork: Looking for missing covers in {{name}}. They show up as they're found.
libraries.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}”? Your files stay where they are.
libraries.goTo: Or type a folder, such as \\nas\media
libraries.podcastsNoFolders: Podcasts don't need a folder. Add shows from the library once it's created.
libraries.podcastsChecked: Checked for new episodes every hour

people.title: People
people.passwordChanged: Password changed. {{name}} was signed out everywhere.
people.confirmRemove: Remove <name>{{name}}</name>? Their watch history, watch list, downloads and requests go too, and they're signed out everywhere. This can't be undone.

account.title: Your account
account.hint: At least 8 characters. Your other devices will be signed out.
account.changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

home.title: Home network
home.required: Everyone signs in, at home and away.
home.open: Phones, TVs and browsers on your home network can watch without signing in. They share one Home account and can't change anything. Away from home, everyone signs in.

homeRows.title: Home
homeRows.holidaysDetail: In the month before Valentine’s Day, Easter, Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas, and the week before New Year’s Eve, Home leads with a row of titles for the day, picked by their keywords, titles and descriptions.

remote.title: Remote access
remote.publicURL: Away from home, the apps connect to <url>{{url}}</url>, the address this server was set up with.
remote.publicURLHomeOnly: <url>{{url}}</url>, the address this server was set up with, only leads to an address on your home network, so the apps can’t use it away from home.
remote.hint: Matinee asks your router to open a port and gets a certificate so the apps connect securely from anywhere. Everyone signs in from outside.
remote.working: Opening a port on your router and getting a certificate…
remote.ready: The apps reach this server at <url>{{url}}</url> when they’re away from home.
remote.router: Your router opened the port over {{router}}.
remote.pickUp: They pick this address up next time they’re on your home network.
remote.retry: Matinee tries again every half hour.
remote.forwardHint: If your router won’t open a port when asked, forward port 443 (or 80) in its settings to port {{port}} on this computer, then pick that port here.
remote.findable: If your home’s internet address changes, the apps still find this server.
remote.direct: The apps always connect straight to this server, never through anyone else’s, so this needs a public address from your internet provider.

playback.title: Playback
playback.autoPlayHint: When the credits start, the next episode plays after a 10-second countdown you can cancel.
playback.bingeHint: Go straight into the next episode when the credits start. After three in a row without touching anything, you’re asked if you’re still watching.
playback.skipIntrosHint: Jump past a show’s intro by itself, instead of offering a Skip intro button.

trailers.title: Trailers
trailers.remoteOn: Movies and shows offer their trailers from TMDB, which play from YouTube. Trailer files next to your media always show too.
trailers.remoteOff: Only trailer files next to your media show, like “Movie (2020)-trailer.mkv” or anything in a Trailers folder.

transcoding.title: Transcoding
transcoding.intro: Files a device can’t play as they are get converted while you watch. A GPU does that faster and with less load on the server.
transcoding.fullGPU: Video is decoded, resized and encoded on the GPU.
transcoding.encodeOnly: Video is encoded on the GPU and decoded on the CPU.
transcoding.fallback: If the GPU can't handle a file, it plays through the CPU instead.
transcoding.cpuOff: The CPU. Hardware transcoding is off.
transcoding.cpuFailed: The CPU, because the accelerator you chose didn’t work on this server.
transcoding.cpuNoGPU: The CPU. No GPU on this server passed its test.
transcoding.auto: Automatic: the best one that works
transcoding.adaptiveDetail: Players offer Auto and fixed qualities. Auto steps the picture down when the connection is slow and back up when it recovers. Converted video is made in several qualities at once, which takes more from the server.
transcoding.stepsDetail: The qualities adaptive streams are made in and people can pick. Without a GPU, Auto uses the best one and one from the middle.
transcoding.capDetail: The best quality a device away from home gets, even with adaptive quality off. Anything better is converted down to it.

tmdb.title: Posters and details
tmdb.intro: Posters, descriptions, cast and trailers for movies and TV come from TMDB, with a free API key. <guide>How to get one</guide>
tmdb.usingSaved: Using the key saved here, ending in {{hint}}.
tmdb.usingEnvironment: Using the key from MATINEE_TMDB_KEY, ending in {{hint}}. A key saved here replaces it.
tmdb.usingBuiltIn: Using the key built into Matinee. A key saved here replaces it.
tmdb.none: No key yet, so movies and TV only use artwork files next to your media.
tmdb.label: TMDB API key
tmdb.saved: Saved. Matinee is filling in posters and details now.

podcastIndex.title: Podcast search
podcastIndex.intro: Searching for podcasts uses Podcast Index, a free and open directory. Get a free API key and secret at <site>api.podcastindex.org</site>. Shows can always be added by their feed address without one.
podcastIndex.none: No key yet, so people add shows by their feed address.

subtitles.title: Subtitle search
subtitles.intro: People can find subtitles a video doesn't have from the player's subtitles menu. Searching uses OpenSubtitles.com: get a free API key at <site>opensubtitles.com/consumers</site>.
subtitles.usingAccount: Using the key ending in {{hint}}, signed in as {{username}}.
subtitles.none: No key yet, so the player's subtitles menu has no search.
subtitles.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the saved key
subtitles.accountHint: Optional: the username and password of a free OpenSubtitles account let the server fetch more subtitle files a day.

connect.title: Matinee Connect
connect.about: Keeps the apps able to find this server when your home’s internet address changes. It only ever learns the address: video always goes straight from this server to the apps.
connect.active: Active until {{date}}. It renews by itself.
connect.waiting: Waiting for the payment to go through…
connect.ended: The subscription has ended. Until you subscribe again, the apps learn a new address only when they’re home.
connect.paid: Billed in advance by Yeix. Cancel anytime; it runs to the end of the period you paid for.

you.title: You
you.hint: Language, look, playback and your devices

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.hint: Folders, new files, analysis and imports

content.title: Content
content.hint: Posters, podcast and subtitle search, trailers and Home rows

health.title: Server health
health.hint: Load, playback, jobs, problems and the log

language.title: Language
language.label: Show Matinee in
language.hint: Your language follows you to the Matinee apps on your phone and TV. Titles and descriptions come in it too, where TMDB has them.
language.guestHint: Everyone at home without an account shares this language.
language.machine: This language was translated by machine, so some words may read oddly.

discover.title: Discover
discover.connectIt: Connect Overseerr to see what's trending, get recommendations, and ask for new movies and shows.
discover.notConnected: An admin hasn't connected Overseerr to this server.
discover.waiting: Waiting for an admin to approve it.
discover.onItsWay: It'll show up in your library once it's downloaded.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Plugins add new kinds of libraries and their own players, such as arcade games. They run walled off from the rest of the server, and only reach what's listed for them here.
plugins.catalogFailed: Couldn't load the official plugins. You can still install one from a link or a file.
plugins.unsupported: Made for a different version of Matinee.
plugins.confirmOn: Turn on {{name}}? It will be able to reach {{hosts}}.
plugins.events: reactions to what happens on the server
plugins.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Its libraries stay but stop updating, and what it saved for everyone, such as saved games, is deleted.
plugins.noPlayer: This needs a plugin that's turned off. An admin can turn it on in Settings, under Plugins.

cover.title: Cover for {{title}}
cover.none: No covers found online. Paste an image's address, or upload one.
cover.chosenNote: This cover was picked by hand, so scans keep it.

import.title: Import from another media server
import.intro: Bring watched marks, places to resume from, collections and custom posters over. Your media files stay where they are.
import.whereHelp: Pick the other server's data folder, as this server sees it, or upload its library database file.
import.suggestion: Paths look different on this server. Files this change finds: {{number}}
import.peopleHelp: Pick who each person is here. Skipped people's history isn't brought over.
import.history: Watched: {{watched}} · In progress: {{inProgress}} · In your libraries: {{found}}
import.watched: Watched marks and places to resume from
import.noPosters: Posters (only from a data folder, not an uploaded database)
import.stopped: The import stopped partway. Run it again to finish; nothing is brought over twice.
import.summary: Watched: {{watched}} · Places to resume: {{inProgress}} · Collections: {{collections}} · Posters: {{posters}}
import.kept: Left as they were, because they were watched more recently here: {{number}}

invite.title: Join {{server}}
invite.invitedBy: {{name}} invited you to watch on their Matinee.
invite.invited: You're invited to watch on this Matinee.
invite.welcomeHint: You can watch right here in your browser, or on your phone and TV.
invite.apps: Watch on your phone or TV
invite.appsHint: Get the Matinee app, choose Add server, and type this address. Then sign in with your new username and password.

friends.title: Friends
friends.hint: Invite people outside your household. Each invite link makes one account that sees only the libraries you pick.
friends.homeOnly: Your server can't be reached from outside your home yet, so invite links only work on your home network.
friends.made: Send this link to your friend:
friends.shareText: Here's your invite to my Matinee.

health.title: Server health
health.intro: How the server is doing right now, for when something isn't working. Everything here comes from this server and stays on it.
health.noHistory: The chart fills in over the next minute.

status.problems_one: {{count}} warning or error in the last hour
status.problems_other: {{count}} warnings or errors in the last hour

scope.group: Matinee and the FFmpeg processes it runs.
scope.process: Matinee itself; FFmpeg processes aren't counted.

transcodes.title: Transcodes
transcodes.stopHint: Stops FFmpeg. If the player is still open, it starts a new transcode.

problems.title: Warnings and errors
problems.none: No warnings or errors since the server started.

jobs.title: Background jobs
jobs.notScanned: Not scanned since the server started

disks.title: Disk space
disks.unreachable: This folder didn't answer. If it's on a network share, check the share is still connected.

log.title: Log
log.intro: The latest {{count}} lines since the server started. The full log is wherever the server's output goes, such as the container's log.
